overview_description.description: Granola is an AI-powered notepad that captures, transcribes, and organizes conversations into structured notes. The platform runs locally during meetings and combines user input with automated transcription to produce summaries, action items, and key points. It integrates with common video conferencing and productivity tools, allowing users to review and edit notes after discussions. Granola also supports search and retrieval of past meetings, helping teams reference decisions and follow-ups. The system is designed for individuals and teams that manage frequent meetings and require documented outputs for coordination and tracking.
